---
title: ""
page-layout: full
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          #quarto-content.page-columns {
            display: block !important;
          }

          #quarto-content,
          .quarto-container,
          main,
          main.content,
          #quarto-document-content {
            max-width: 100% !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }

          .cv-header {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 1rem 2rem 0.75rem;
          }

          .cv-download {
            font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--card-accent);
            text-decoration: none;
            border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
            padding-bottom: 2px;
            transition: color 0.2s;
          }

          .cv-download:hover {
            color: var(--card-text);
          }

          .cv-embed-wrap {
            max-width: 1300px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 1rem 1rem;
          }

          .cv-embed-wrap iframe {
            width: 100%;
            height: 94vh;
            height: 94dvh;
            border: none;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 20px var(--card-shadow);
          }

          /* Mobile: many phone browsers can't render embedded PDFs well;
             fall back to a clear link instead of a broken/frozen iframe */
          @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .cv-embed-wrap iframe {
              display: none;
            }
            .cv-mobile-fallback {
              display: block;
            }
          }
          .cv-mobile-fallback {
            display: none;
            text-align: center;
            font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif;
            color: var(--card-text);
            padding: 2rem;
          }
        </style>
---

```{=html}
<div class="cv-header">
  <a class="cv-download" href="cv_hv.pdf" download>Download PDF</a>
</div>

<div class="cv-embed-wrap">
  <iframe src="cv_hv.pdf#toolbar=0" title="Hayden Vega CV"></iframe>
  <div class="cv-mobile-fallback">
    <p>PDF preview isn't available on this device.</p>
    <a class="cv-download" href="cv_hv.pdf" download>Download the CV</a>
  </div>
</div>
```
